Title: BRIEF_SCHEMA
Text: Required fields:  - `SOURCE_PDF_NAME` - `PAGE_NUM` - `TILE_ID` - `SOURCE_RASTER_PATH` - `TILE_IMAGE_PATH` - `OUTPUT_PATH` - `MODE`: `basic` or `detailed` - `TILE_GEOMETRY`: `tile_grid`, `body_box_px`, `body_exclusions`, `read_box_px`, `emit_box_px`, `overlap_px`, `mini_grid`  Optional fields:  - `ALLOW_REFERENCE_SHEETS` - `SCOPE_FILE` - `BASIC_REFERENCE_RUN` - `BASIC_COUNTS_CSV`  The brief must include the canonical output template rendered by `build_pandid_valve_tile_brief.py`.
